question: How many Lok Sabha constituencies are there in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**543**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Lok Sabha**, also known as the** House of the People**, is the **lower house** of India's bicameral Parliament.
 
• Its **members are chosen by direct election on the basis of adult suffrage to represent their respective constituencies**, and they serve terms of **five years** or until the body is dissolved by the President on the recommendation of the council of ministers.
 
• The Lok Sabha is composed of representatives of people chosen by direct election on the basis of Universal Adult Suffrage.
 
• The Constitution of India allows for a maximum of 550 members in the House, with 530 members representing the States and 20 representing the Union Territories.
 
• At present, the Lok Sabha has 543 seats filled by elected representatives. The term of the Lok Sabha, unless dissolved, is five years from the date appointed for its first meeting.
 
• However, while a proclamation of emergency is in operation, this period may be extended by Parliament by law for a period not exceeding one year at a time and not extending in any case, beyond a period of six months after the proclamation has ceased to operate.
 
• There are now **543 Lok Sabha constituencies in In****dia**, with the **most constituencies** being in **Uttar Pradesh (80)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** President, Lok Sabha, and Rajya Sabha** together make up the **Parliament of India**.
 
• The **Rajya Sabha and Lok Sabha** are both essential parts of India's parliament. The Lok sabha has** 543 members**, whereas the Rajya sabha has **250 members** .
 
• The majority of **state-related decisions **are made based on votes cast by Rajya sabha members, but **no decision may be made for the state without the consent of the Lok Sabha **members.
 
• Both the** Speaker and the Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha** are chosen by a simple **majority of the members present and voting** to serve as the House's presiding authorities. The Constitution merely stipulates that the **Speaker must be a member of the House**; no other requirements are set forth for election as Speaker.
